trades.rationale: Whales added ~270,000 BTC amid record ETF outflows, but a fresh four-day BTC ETF outflow streak (-$49.7M on July 28) into the FOMC decision keeps risk two-sided; watch for a break above $65K or below $63K post-Fed.
ETH spot ETFs have posted three straight weeks of net inflows and are now outpacing BTC ETF flows, while ETH held above $1,900 through the Korea chip-crash selloff that hit other risk assets harder.
Solana is named among the altcoins with the strongest July catalysts alongside Hyperliquid and Ondo, and has shown relative technical strength through the recent macro-driven correction.
ONDO broke out of an accumulation zone with a 17% weekly gain, riding the RWA/tokenization narrative that's cited as one of the few altcoin sectors with measurable real usage right now.
Ethena whale balances jumped roughly 3,166% in 24 hours with ~20M ENA accumulated in a single day, coinciding with a 14.4% weekly price gain.
On-chain trackers show whales adding 180,000 AAVE (~$16M) in accumulation, consistent with continued DeFi TVL growth (DefiLlama total TVL ~$75.8B, +1.04% 24h).
Whale wallets have been carefully accumulating roughly 380,000 UNI, a pattern flagged alongside AAVE and ENA as notable pre-breakout on-chain positioning.

BEAT already rallied ~50% on the week, but faces the largest single unlock of any token this cycle on Aug 1 ($74.9M, a 2.12% supply cliff) — classic setup for post-unlock sell pressure into a stretched rally.
EIGEN has a $7.65M unlock (2.02% of supply) landing Aug 1, adding dilution risk right as broader risk sentiment stays fragile (Fear & Greed at 29).

HYPE lost up to 10% in the Korea AI-chip rout and Hyperliquid had to cover $60M in liquidations after an SK Hynix-linked perp contract crashed 19%, pointing to elevated leverage risk in the platform's exotic listings.

unlocks.note: Cliff unlock, ~48% of next week's total unlock value across all tracked tokens.

Ongoing daily release; supply dilution comparable to BEAT/EIGEN.

btc.trend: Fourth straight day of net outflows as of July 28 (-$49.7M), led by BlackRock's IBIT (-$54.8M) and partly offset by Grayscale's Mini Trust (+$5.1M); 2026 cumulative net outflows have narrowed to ~$4.84B from ~$5.4B earlier in July.

eth.trend: Three consecutive weeks of net inflows (~$84M, ~$105M, ~$103.9M) despite a $70.6M single-day outflow on July 24; ETH ETF flows have recently outpaced BTC ETF flows, signaling a rotation into ether.
